item.title: Meta Unveils Free Facebook Verified Badge for Humans
item.description: Meta introduces a free Facebook Verified badge that uses a video selfie check to prove a profile belongs to a real person, curbing AI‑generated fakes.

item.title: Meta Launches Seller Marketplace App with Free Verified
item.description: Meta launches a Marketplace seller app and a free Facebook Verified badge to boost trust, simplify selling, and challenge rivals in commerce.
